definition: Unpredictable changes in behaviour, mood, or circumstance.
author: Emily Brontë
quote: He held the knife in his hand, and pushed its point between my teeth: but, for my part, I was never much afraid of his vagaries.
example_sentence: Farmers live at the mercy of the vagaries of the weather.
